blocks.text: ULAANBAATAR, Mongolia — Mongolia’s President Ukhnaa Khurelsukh announced his resignation on Tuesday following corruption allegations and impeachment threats from the country’s opposition party. His resignation announcement comes a day after the opposition Democratic Party issued a statement accusing him of graft and calling for him to step down or face impeachment in parliament. Khurelsukh told a press conference he was being “falsely accused and defamed with allegations of extremely serious crimes” and would resign in order to “restore my good name”.
